title: Why Apple just killed the iPhone

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Look at this — Apple just buried the iPhone in the next big update.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t just a software change, it’s a total hardware shift.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They’re killing the iPhone’s headphone jack and replacing it with a USB-C port.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The new iPhone 16 will only have a USB-C port — no more Lightning or headphone jack.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects millions of users still relying on old accessories and headphones.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Apple is pushing everyone toward universal charging standards.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: So, are you ready to ditch your old chargers and headphones?

caption_text: Why Apple just killed the iPhone
